desc: 披肩式挡风片、同料系带收腰、贴袋袖袢的米白中长廓形风衣
leaf: 女士米白披肩式挡风片同料系带中长风衣外套
name: 米白披肩挡风片系带风衣款

shots.intent: 详情页首屏用杂志式留白版式与整件廓形立住气质，一秒给出继续下滑的理由
shots.textZone: left 35% column: one letterspaced eyebrow line, one headline with a greige highlight bar, one short sub-label

shots.intent: 让买家把自己代入春秋通勤出街的真实状态，验证廓形上身效果
用编号引线只指向画面里真实可见的结构，解释这件外套的版型好在哪
shots.textZone: right 35% column: one headline plus four short letterspaced labels, each tied to one numbered leader line

shots.intent: 用掠射微距证明面料质地与滚边车缝是真的，而不是修图出来的
同一机位同一光的上下两联，让肩线与挡风片的挺括差别一眼可见
shots.textZone: left edge of each panel: one short letterspaced label, underlined

shots.intent: 把面料的手感与分量转成可看的原料证据，回答穿着舒不舒服
shots.textZone: upper band: three unfilled index bars with blank tick marks, each reserved for one short label

shots.intent: 用正侧机位的行走瞬间展示垂坠与摆幅，打消上身显臃肿的顾虑
在同一屏里一次性消除选码与版型档位疑问，格内数字留给卖家自填
shots.textZone: card column: four short underlined micro-labels plus one empty grid reserved for data

shots.intent: 让买家在同一版式里比较颜色，一次看完再决定
shots.textZone: under each cell: one short letterspaced colour label, four in total

shots.intent: 用可核验的车缝与辅料特写加单权重线性图标降低下单风险
shots.textZone: one headline above the grid plus four card captions, each one bold label and one thin sub-line

shots.intent: 用一个行动按钮收口，把前面建立的偏好转成下单动作
shots.textZone: right third: one short line plus one squared action button

style.backgroundSystem: three consistent planes kept identical across the set: paper white #FFFFFF base field, warm oatmeal #EFE9E0 block panel, and one pale dotted-paper variant #F7F3EC; on-body screens are limited to a plain matte pale plaster facade #E7DFD4 with a perforated pale metal panel and a pale stone floor, never a random location; one offset greige #B5A695 rectangle sits behind every inset photo block as the layout signature
style.direction: quiet premium minimalist womenswear outerwear editorial commerce
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons in deep charcoal #2D2D2D, no fills, no gradients, one abstract geometric glyph per card, identical stroke weight and diameter across all four cards, no pictograms of seals, awards, lab reports or certification marks
style.lightingSystem: soft overcast daylight balance, diffused front-left key with a white bounce card on the shadow side, near 5600K, low contrast, matte fabric sheen that never turns glossy, honest soft contact shadow that always grounds the garment, no hard speculars and no contradictory light directions
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent quiet premium minimalist womenswear outerwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of paper white #FFFFFF, warm oatmeal field #EFE9E0, deep charcoal type #2D2D2D, greige block accent #B5A695 and one misty blue secondary accent #94A9B8; neutral daylight-balanced tone held identical on every screen; one modern geometric sans-serif family with a wide-letterspaced eyebrow line, one greige #B5A695 highlight bar under headline key words and a three-dot vertical section divider, no serif and no script; background system of paper white fields, oatmeal block panels and one pale dotted-paper variant #F7F3EC, with on-body screens limited to a matte pale plaster facade #E7DFD4 plus perforated pale metal; lighting system of soft overcast daylight near 5600K, diffused front-left key with white bounce fill, low contrast, matte fabric sheen and an honest soft contact shadow grounding the garment; layout system of a magazine-style side type column, flat square-cornered cards, thin hairline rules, offset greige rectangles behind inset photo blocks, small numbered circles on thin leader lines, one blank-header table grid and single-weight thin line icons in #2D2D2D with no fills and no seals; product shown only as an invisible ghost form, a true flat lay, or a worn view cropped from the chin down so no face ever enters frame, with true garment colour, visible drape and tailoring lines and stable scale and hem position; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented spec numbers or certificates, no store marks.
noDrift: no visible model face or identifiable person
no invented spec numbers, percentages, weights, prices, certificates or store marks
no glossy synthetic sheen and no over-smoothed plastic fabric
style.presentationRules: three locked scales only: the garment on an invisible ghost form, a true flat lay from above, and a worn view cropped from the chin down so no face ever enters frame; the garment keeps the same hem position, sleeve length and hardware placement in every screen; drape, fall, tailoring lines and fabric weight are read from the reference image and never redrawn; the waist tie, the overlaid shoulder panel and the patch pockets stay exactly where the reference puts them
style.surfaceSystem: matte plaster wall #E7DFD4, pale stone floor, untextured paper panels #FFFFFF / #EFE9E0 / #F7F3EC; macro and fibre screens use a soft out-of-focus pale field #F5F0E8
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for every rendered line; wide-letterspaced caps only for the short eyebrow line, headline set in the same family with one greige #B5A695 highlight bar under the key words, a three-dot vertical divider as the section mark, micro labels small and letterspaced; no serif, no script handwriting, no retro or cartoon faces
